basis: Asked by the agent on 24 November 2026 how Bro Hof should reach main, the owner chose "Owner acceptance": a dated record that admits Bro Hof as advisory like the other ten grounds, names what is not proven, keeps the structure and file checks, and leaves the full review required for any other new ground.

open.canonical-control-pending: No independent horizontal or RH 2000 ground control has been measured at Bro Hof. The frame is the 1 m national terrain and the 0.16 m orthophoto, which agree with each other.
open.canonical-frame: The ground's origin is fixed in software and has not been approved against independent control, as at every other ground.
open.release-review: The 14-gate release review does not exist: no phone timings, no per-hole review by a person, no offline or rollback rehearsal on this candidate.
open.surface-intake-pending: All 36 holes were traced on the 2025 orthophoto and looked through hole by hole by the agent on 24 November (paired overlays); the owner has not reviewed the outlines.
